purpose: Bounded engineering acceptance of single-lane MICRO blocked handoff and physical spillback, separately from SUMO equivalence and empirical validation.
scope: Static Car routes, fixed membership, 0.1-second ticks, downstream lookahead, optional fixed connector, no competing movements or lane changes.
execution: Development case first; retain baseline and failures.
Freeze engine parameters before running reserved cases. No threshold or traffic-coefficient fitting to reserved results.
Run reserved complete cases under both policies on one JVM and compare full physical reports; repeat at least one on two JVMs with delayed transport.
Run blocked-horizon case under both policies; no modeled sends from horizon finalization.
Exercise request cancellation, restored pending footprint and correlated grant replay in focused tests.
Retain input, protocol and executable SHA256, commands, logs, physical measurements, exclusions and all failures.
Run existing v2 and legacy compatibility diagnostics without altering their frozen protocols.
claimBoundary: Physical representation, spacing and runtime consistency in bounded fixtures. Finite count capacity is an admission constraint, not an empirical saturated-flow estimate. No general spillback, intersection, SUMO equivalence, field accuracy or city-scale performance claim.
